chart_references: The second report, published a day later by Ember, a research firm, focuses on electricity markets. It, too, highlights some record-breaking feats. In 2025, for the first time ever, new renewables generation exceeded the rise in global electricity demand (see chart). And for the first time in over a century, renewables managed to produce more electricity (34%) worldwide than coal did (33%).

extraction.title: Vitamin-D therapy
extraction.subtitle: Renewables are shining. The Iran war amplifies their appeal Two new reports are a must-read of energy-starved governments
extraction.summary: The ongoing Gulf war is shifting energy dynamics, favoring clean energy, particularly solar power, over fossil fuels. Reports indicate a significant rise in renewable energy generation, with solar surpassing coal for the first time. The cost of solar energy has drastically decreased, making it a viable alternative amid geopolitical tensions.
